answer: I read the default calibration of garnet with get_calibration_quality_metrics(). The pair with the highest CZ IRB fidelity is QB12-QB17. Its metric is metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB17.fidelity, with a value of 0.99877734 (uncertainty 0.00037). The runner-up is QB12-QB7 at 0.99877631, which is only about 1e-6 lower. That gap is far smaller than the uncertainty. I ran a Bell circuit on physical qubits QB12 and QB17 on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit was prx(pi/2) on both qubits, then CZ, then prx(-pi/2) on QB17, then one measure on (QB12, QB17). The job ID is 01a15f3b-cd10-7246-8ede-a7cabce5624e and the job completed. The counts were 00: 51 and 11: 49. The scripts are in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-50 (calib.py, find.py, bell.py, calib.json).
